description: Resumable tracker for the shared-features project-wide audit + remediation. Read this FIRST on every re-run of the originating prompt. Find first non-completed batch in batches[], execute it end-to-end, run quality gate, update this file, stop. One batch per session.

issuesFound.title: Raw console.* callsites in website/src/ violate centralized-logger discipline
issuesFound.details: 9 direct console.* calls found by grep. Of these, 4 are inside the project's local logger shim or the errorTracking init (analytics.ts inline logger, errorTracking.ts Sentry-init fallbacks) and are intentional. The other 5 are app code that should route through a centralized logger module:
callsites: website/src/context/AuthContext.tsx:51 — console.error('Failed to fetch user document:', error)
website/src/pages/marketing/FeatureFlagsDetailPage.tsx:122 — console.log('Advertising is disabled via feature flags')

batches.name: Centralized logger + console.* migration in website/
tasks: Create website/src/utils/logger.ts mirroring the lifewell pattern (variadic API, default level=warn, runtime override via localStorage['sharedfeatures:logLevel'])
Migrate the 5 app-code console.* callsites in F-LOGGER (AuthContext, FeatureFlagsDetailPage, SettingsPage, SeedDataPage) to logger.*
Leave the 4 intentional callsites in analytics.ts + errorTracking.ts alone (or replace with new logger if convenient)
Add ESLint 'no-console: error' to website's eslint config with logger.ts as the only exception
Verify: yarn typecheck && yarn lint clean
batches.actualNotes: Created website/src/lib/logger.ts (centralized logger, 198 lines, mirrors the lifewell pattern with sharedfeatures:logLevel localStorage key + VITE_LOG_LEVEL env override + __setLogLevel/__getLogLevel devtools helpers + console.log/info/debug/trace patching at boot). Migrated all 5 raw console.* app-code callsites to logger.* with matching levels: AuthContext (logger.error), FeatureFlagsDetailPage (logger.log), SettingsPage (logger.error), SeedDataPage x2 (logger.error). The 4 intentional callsites in lib/errorTracking.ts (Sentry-init fallback warn + ultimate-fallback error) and lib/analytics.ts (inline-logger shim warn + dev-only debug) remain untouched as they are init-time fallbacks not subject to the centralized-logger rule.

verification.postMigrationConsoleCheck: only 4 intentional callsites remain (errorTracking.ts + analytics.ts as documented)
verification.eslintNoConsoleRule: deferred — not enforced via lint config yet; project relies on grep-based audit

resumeProtocol.step2: If lastSuccessfulRun is <7 days ago AND every batch is completed: bump verifiedAt, run yarn typecheck + yarn build at root and at website/, stop.
resumeProtocol.step3: If any batch is in_progress: resume that batch first.
resumeProtocol.step4: If every batch is completed: rerun the audit-phase checks (banned packages, secrets, console-discipline, typecheck, build at both root and website). If issues found, add them as new batches. If clean, set lastSuccessfulRun=today and report done.
resumeProtocol.step5: Otherwise: pick the first pending batch, execute, commit, mark completed.
